Questions we get asked

Will customers know they're talking to AI?

The assistant introduces itself as your business and keeps it short and plain. It handles the first few messages — booking, availability, basic details — then hands straight over to you. Nothing pretends to be you.

What if I already use a CRM or job management app?

Tell us what you're on and we'll connect to it rather than replace it. Jobber, ServiceM8, Tradify and simple spreadsheets all work fine.

How much should I put behind ads?

Most small businesses start around £400–£800 a month. We'll tell you honestly if your area or sector doesn't have the search volume to make it worth it.

How quickly will I see enquiries?

Missed-call and follow-up work starts paying off in the first fortnight. Paid campaigns usually need four to six weeks before the cost per booked job settles.

Do you only work with certain industries?

No. If your business relies on enquiries turning into booked work, the system fits. We're Cardiff based and know the local market best, but we work across the UK.
